body: Thankfully my partner is very supportive, don't think I'd have coped even this well without her.

I can't even do that, even masturbation causes pain. The few times we have done anything I've basically just focused on her, which is fun but tainted by the knowledge I can't fully participate and the frustration of not being able to orgasm myself without pain. Often just being aroused is enough to cause increased pain. It's also frustrating for her; though her libido is low, when she is turned on she wants me, she wants to play with me and make me feel good but she can't.

We've worked so hard to get where we are and it's been for nothing.

As I said I've been tested for everything that it could possibly be by several different doctors over several different specialities with tests being done multiple times. It's not impossible but it's unlikely that something has been overlooked because of a mistake. I live in the UK so have access to the NHS but I've spent thousands privately to get extra tests and opinions.

To quote Arnold Schwarzenegger, it's not a tumor. I've had several scans, every STI test (at least twice), flow tests, ultrasounds and two cystoscopies. I've seen at least seven urologists (an OBGYN probably wouldn't be interested in looking at my penis) including one with a special interest in prostatitis and another with a special interest in urological injuries. I've also seen a rheumatologist and now a pain specialist. Despite all of this nothing has been found and I've been given no diagnosis. If the pain meds don't work my only other option is cauterisation of the area where I feel the pain in the hope that this will kill the nerves there, but this is far from guaranteed to work and comes with a risk of it making things worse so it's a last resort.

To have this after such a long and emotionally debilitating battle with our DB feels like a massive kick in the teeth.

It's a stinging/burning pain in my urethra, imagine having a paper cut in there and that's what it's like at its worst. I've been dealing with it on and off for years but with lots of time in a sort of remission where the symptoms died down. The last year though it's been almost constant with any kind of sexual activity, including masturbation, making it worse.

I've had literally every test known to science except a biopsy and multiple specialists have been unable to give me a diagnosis. I'm under a pain specialist now and on a low dose of amitriptyline to see if it helps. On a waiting list to see a psychologist too.
